t: The Saxby Sight fixed recessed LED emergency downlight provides essential illumination. It is a reliable non-maintained emergency lighting solution. The downlight is suitable for commercial installations, such as offices, corridors, and public buildings, ensuring safety during power outages. It features an integrated 2W LED, delivering 120 lumens of 6500K daylight illumination. The unit includes an LED driver and battery control gear, offering a 3-hour emergency run time. Its compact 60mm diameter and 50mm cut-out make for straightforward recessed fitting, with a durable polycarbonate body.
b: Includes LED Driver & Battery Control Gear
